requirement.summary: Reserve sessions for each client login to improve overall login performance
requirement.description:
To resolve slow login times when creating new sessions, this enhancement introduces a configurable session reservation pool.

- Configurable Session Pool: The system now allows defining a specific number of reserved, pre-established sessions.

- Performance Improvement: Upon workstation login, the system utilizes an available reserved session directly, improving login speed and performance.
requirement.release_notes:
Enhancements: [Jira-69102] Reserve sessions for each client login to improve overall login performance (Sunny)
Descriptions:
To resolve slow login times when creating new sessions, this enhancement introduces a configurable session reservation pool.
Configurable Session Pool: The system now allows defining a specific number of reserved, pre-established sessions.
Performance Improvement: Upon workstation login, the system utilizes an available reserved session directly, improving login speed and performance.
Setup:
Setup for total number of sessions reserved and number of sessions for each client
<Drive>:\infrasys\local\hero_pos\cfg\config.ini
[setup]
reserved_php_session_pool_size=<Total number of sessions reserved>
reserved_php_session_per_client=<Number of sessions for each client>
E.g.
reserved_php_session_pool_size=16
reserved_php_session_per_client=8
*** POS Launcher Service is required to restart

requirement.summary: API Portal - Check maximum quantity to order of set menu incorrectly and cause bypassing price level change for child item
requirement.description:
Issue 1:

System wrongly apply "Max. quantity to order" API portal. System uses the n-1 th child item in the "childitems" payload as qty

Prerequisite:

1. Setting menu maximum quantity

* Location: Menu Management > Item Properties > Menus

* Section name: Ordering Control - Set Menu Ordering

* Setup name: Max. quantity to order

> Setting value as 1 or larger

Workflow:

1. System receives request "Send check" (including "Send and pay") to order a self-selection set menu with child item "belong to lookup list" included with quantity is larger than allowed maximum

2. System pass the checking of maximum quantity to order even if the quantity is larger than maximum quantity (first child item = 1 - 1 = 0, so the first child item always pass the checking)

Actual result:

System pass the checking of Max. qty to order even if the qty is larger than Max. qty

Expected result:

System return error if the qty is larger than Max. qty

Returns error when quantity is larger than Max. quantity to order in API portal AND Support Max Ordering Quantity Validation for Self-Selection Set Menu Child Items = Yes

New setups:

Provide new setup in config by location to keep existing behavior:

* Location: POS System > Ordering Setup > Conifg by Location

* Setup name: Set Menu Setting for API Portal

> Sub setting name: Support Max Ordering Quantity Validation for Self-Selection Set Menu Child Items

> Default: No

Issue 2:

System cannot change price level for child item in self-selection set menu when the n-1th child item in request equal to or larger than "Max. quantity to order" in menu setup

Prerequisite:

1. Setting menu maximum quantity

* Location: Menu Management > Item Properties > Menus

* Section name: Ordering Control - Set Menu Ordering

* Setup name: Max. quantity to order

> Setting value as 1 or larger

2. Setting change price level for self-select menu

* Location: Menu Management > Item Properties > Set Menu

* Select target self-select menu

* Setup name: Change Price Level

> Setting value as "Yes"

> Setting target price level as non default price level

Workflow:

1. System receive request "Send check" to order a self-selection set menu with child item "belong to lookup list" provided and the n-1th child item in request equal to or larger than the "Max. quantity to order" in menu setup

2. System check the maximum quantity condition incorrectly (system check the condition  nth child item in request equal to or larger than "Max. quantity to order"), and so bypass the change price level handling

3. System cannot get the correct price level and change the price level

Actual result:

System doesn't change the price level of child item even if the quantity of child item doesn't exceed the maximum quantity to order

Expected result:

System changes the price level of child item for the applied self-select child item
requirement.release_notes:
Bug Fixing: [Jira-67966] API Portal - Check maximum quantity to order of set menu incorrectly and cause bypassing price level change for child item (Christopher)
Descriptions:
System checks the maximum order quantity for self-selection child item incorrectly by using the (N-1)-th child item Json object in the "childitems" payload, and this causes:
System bypasses set menu price level change handling for the self-selection child item which is the M-th (M = the value in Setup 1) child item Json object in the "childitems" payload
System applies the self-selection child item that exceeds the child item order quantity limit from Setup 1
Workflow
1. System receives the "Send check" / "Send and pay" / "Park order by station" / "Park order by table" request that order the self-selection set menu with the child item that belongs to a lookup list and the total child item quantity is larger than the value in Setup 1
2. If Setup 3 does not exist or exists with value as “No”, system will bypass the maximum order quantity validation for self-selection child items, and go to step 6
3. If Setup 3 exists with values as “Yes”, system will perform maximum order quantity validation for self-selection child items, and go to step 4
4. If the total quantity of self-selection child items is larger than the value in Setup 1, system will return the error response
5. If the total quantity of self-selection child items is NOT larger than the value in Setup 1, go to step 6
6. System will change price level for the applied self-selection child items by the price level value in Setup 2
7. System continues the existing workflow
Expected Result:
System returns an error message “Exceed child max order limit” if that total quantity of the self-selection child items is larger than the value in Setup 1 and Setup 3 exists with values as “Yes”
System changes the price level for the applied self-selection child items
It is fixed in current version
Setup:
Set the maximum quantity to order for the menu [Setup 1]
Go to Menu Management à Item Properties à Menus
Select the section "Ordering Control - Set Menu Ordering"
Select setup "Max. quantity to order"
Set the target value
Click “Save” to save the record
Set the price level for the self-selection set menu [Setup 2]
Go to Menu Management à Item Properties à Set Menu
Select the target self-selection set menu
Select setup "Change Price Level"
Set the target price level value
Click “Save” to save the record
Setup to support max Ordering Quantity Validation for Self-Selection Set Menu Child Items [Setup 3]
Go to POS System à Ordering Setup à Config by Location
Select setup "Set Menu Setting for API Portal"
Set “Support Max Ordering Quantity Validation for Self-Selection Set Menu Child Items” = Yes
Click “Save” to save the record

requirement.summary: TMS 2.0 - Payby Access Token globally cached for all outlets
requirement.description:
Email/Zoho title:

-

Use Case:

Payby Access Token is globally cached without idendically saved for differernt setting on outlets.

Steps to Reproduce:

1. Setup different PayBy in two outlets.

2. Go to operation mode, use outlet a call for payment method (get outlet A PayBy access token)

3. Close dialog and switch outlet to Outlet B, get access token again

Current Result:

Popup error: "Error fetching 3rd party payment methods: third_party_error: client is not found"

[Unexpected]

Expected Result:

No error popup

[Expected]
requirement.release_notes:
Enhancement : [HERO-69083] TMS 2.0 - Payby Access Token globally cached for all outlets
Descriptions :
The Payby access token is stored and identified by payment method ID. An outlet can have more than one Payby payment method. Each method keeps its own cached access token.
This was verified on Infrasys Restaurant. Two new Payby payment methods were created with the same credential settings as the existing Payby payment method. Creating payment in operation for each method produced two separate token cache files.
Setup :
1. Log in to TMS Operation and select outlet Infrasys Restaurant.
2. Open TMS Payment Methods for Infrasys Restaurant. The existing Payby payment method can stay. Create two more Payby payment methods (Type = Interface, Interface = Payby Payment). Use the same gateway, resort, grant type, and client credentials as the existing Payby payment method. Save both as Active.
3. Confirm the listing shows multiple Payby payment methods for the same outlet, all Active. In this test: existing payby payment (ID 5), Payby RN Test A (ID 7), Payby RN Test B (ID 8).
4. Open TMS Operation for Infrasys Restaurant. Open a reservation (new reservation or Search View). Open Deposit Details, click +, and create payment using Payby RN Test A, then create payment using Payby RN Test B. The first call of each method requests an access token.
5. Check the access token cache folder accounts/{account_name}/tmp/cache. There must be one file per payment method ID:
cake_86400_secs_third_party_payment_access_token_payby_7
cake_86400_secs_third_party_payment_access_token_payby_8
6. Confirm the two files exist at the same time and the stored token values are not the same. The outlet must not share one token file.

requirement.summary: [Tech] TMS 2.0 - Disable Master Server URL on Dummy Cloud HQ (Mix)
requirement.description:
Since the On-Premises Dummy HQ (sever type = mix, and is Dummy), by design, does not need to synchronize data from the Master Server.

Please disable the Master Server configuration section to prevent users from mistakenly filling it in and causing synchronization failures.

Additionally, remove the “required” validation for the Master Server URL field from both Data Update (Add On) and Schedule Auto Data Update (Add On) under Admin Page > TMS > Data Synchronization.
requirement.release_notes:
Bug Fixing: [Jira-68781] TMS 2.0 - Disable Master Server URL on Dummy Cloud HQ (Mix)
Descriptions:
Since the On-Premises Dummy HQ (server type = mix, and is Dummy) by design does not need to synchronize data from the Master Server, disable the Master Server configuration section to prevent users from mistakenly filling it in and causing synchronization failures.
Remove the "required" validation for the Master Server URL field from both Data Update (Add On) and Schedule Auto Data Update (Add On) under Admin Page > TMS > Data Synchronization.
Setup:
Test environment: Dummy Cloud HQ (Mix)
Go to System Management > System Configuration > Global Settings, hide the Master Server section
On the first subsequent edit and save of the system configuration, the existing Master Server fields (URL, Security Key, Login Name, Password) will be automatically cleared.
Go to Table Management System > Data Synchronization > Data Update (Add On)
The required indicator and required-field validation have been removed from the Master Server URL, FTP / HTTP Interface, and HTTP Interface fields, allowing them to be left empty
Go to Table Management System > Data Synchronization > Schedule Auto Data Update (Add On),
The required-field checks for Master Server URL, FTP / HTTP Interface, and HTTP Interface have been removed when saving data, allowing them to be saved as empty.

Enhancements: [Jira-68546] TMS 2.0 - Support free text input extra options for special occasions – Dev
Descriptions:
This task is to support free text input on Extra Options (optional selection). Guest / operator can select an extra option (for example Birthday) and type extra details after the option. Typical use is special occasion remarks that cannot be covered by a fixed option list.
New Extra Option setting: Allow Custom Value.
No (empty) — existing behaviour. Only the option can be selected. No text box.
Yes (y) — a text box is shown under the extra option dropdown. Typed text is saved together with the selected option.
Display format is: Option name - typed text. Example: Birthday - 50th birthday, cake with candles.
Typed text is stored in reservation extra info value (tms_resv_extra_infos.rvei_value). System only keeps the text when the selected extra option has Allow Custom Value = Yes. If the option does not allow custom value, typed text is ignored / cleared.
Setup:
HQ – Extra Options
Go to Admin Page -> “Table Management System” (TMS) -> Extra Options
Listing adds column Allow Custom Value. Tick = Yes, cross = No.
The Extra Options listing is as below.
Add New / Edit Extra Option adds field Allow Custom Value. Value No / Yes (empty = No, y = Yes).
Add New Extra Option is as below.
Edit Extra Option is as below.
Default is No. Existing extra options stay No after upgrade until user sets Yes.
View Extra Option also shows Allow Custom Value.
View Extra Option is as below.
Database: tms_extra_options.eopt_allow_custom_value, char(1), not null, default empty. Value y = Yes.
Online Booking – Add / Edit Reservation
When the selected extra option has Allow Custom Value = Yes, a text box is shown under the dropdown. Placeholder: custom extra option.
Online Booking extra option with custom text is as below.
When the selected extra option has Allow Custom Value = No, the text box is hidden and the typed text is cleared.
If user changes to another option then changes back to the original option, the original typed text is restored. If user selects a different option that also allows custom value, the text box is empty.
Confirmation page and booking find result show Option name - typed text. Line break in typed text is kept.
TMS Operation – Add / Edit / View Reservation and Walk-in
Same behaviour as online. When the selected extra option allows custom value, a text box is shown under the extra option dropdown.
Changing the extra option always clears the typed text. User needs to type again after changing option.
Reservation list extra info column, reservation side panel / view, and advanced search result details also show Option name - typed text.
Message / Reservation change log
Notification / message extra option variable uses the same display: Option name - typed text.
Reservation change log records extra option change and typed text change. Example: [Special Occasion] from Birthday - 40th to Birthday - 50th birthday.
If only typed text is changed and the extra option is not changed, change log is still written.
Open API
getOutletSettings
Version 1.5 adds extra_options.allow_custom_value under outlet extra_infos. Version below 1.5 does not return this key (old extra_infos structure is unchanged).
allow_custom_value: empty = No, y = Yes.
Response extra_infos extra_options example
| JSON Sample File – getOutletSettings extra_infos |
| {    "status": "success",    "data": {       "outlet_settings": {          "extra_infos": [             {                "key": "special_occasion",                "type": "o",                "name": "Special Occasion",                "extra_options": [                   {                      "code": "BIRTHDAY",                      "name": "Birthday",                      "allow_custom_value": "y"                   },                   {                      "code": "ANNIVERSARY",                      "name": "Anniversary",                      "allow_custom_value": ""                   }                ]             }          ]       }    } } |
| Variable Name | Value | Data Type | Mandatory | Description |
| allow_custom_value | y | String | N | New from getOutletSettings version 1.5. Empty = No. y = Yes. Omitted when version < 1.5. |
| code | BIRTHDAY | String | Y | Extra option code (eopt_code) |
| name | Birthday | String | Y | Extra option name |
Add / Edit reservation extra_infos (type = o)
For extra type optional selection (type o), pass extra option by code. Typed custom text is extra_infos.value. System only saves value when the matched extra option has allow_custom_value = y. If the option does not allow custom value, or value is empty / null, rvei_value is saved as empty.
code can be top-level extra_infos.code, or extra_options[0].code (same shape as getOutletSettings / find reservation reply).
Request extra_infos example
| JSON Sample File – addResv / editResv extra_infos |
| {    "interface": "openapi",    "module": "tms",    "fcn": "addResv",    "body": {       "shop_code": "SHOP01",       "outlet_code": "OUT01",       "extra_infos": [          {             "key": "special_occasion",             "code": "BIRTHDAY",             "value": "50th birthday, cake with candles"          }       ]    } } |
| Variable Name | Value | Data Type | Mandatory | Description |
| key | special_occasion | String | Y | Extra type key (etyp_key) |
| code | BIRTHDAY | String | Y | Extra option code. Required for type o. Can also pass extra_options[0].code |
| value | 50th birthday, cake with candles | String | N | Custom text for type o. Only accepted when allow_custom_value = y. For type f this is still the free text value |
Find / get reservation extra_infos
For type o, value is the typed custom text. If no custom text, value is null. extra_options still returns the selected option code / name.
extra_info_value is also returned when type o has custom text (same value as value).
Response extra_infos example (type o with custom text)
| JSON Sample File – extra_infos in reservation reply |
| {    "key": "special_occasion",    "type": "o",    "name": "Special Occasion",    "value": "50th birthday, cake with candles",    "extra_info_value": "50th birthday, cake with candles",    "extra_options": [       {          "code": "BIRTHDAY",          "name": "Birthday"       }    ] } |
| Variable Name | Value | Data Type | Mandatory | Description |
| key | special_occasion | String | Y | Extra type key |
| type | o | String | Y | o = optional selection, f = free text |
| name | Special Occasion | String | Y | Extra type name |
| value | 50th birthday, cake with candles | String | N | For type o: custom text, or null when empty. For type f: free text |
| extra_info_value | 50th birthday, cake with candles | String | N | Returned only when type o has custom text |
| extra_options | [{}] | Array | N | Selected extra option code / name |
resv_extra_infos (Open API version 2.3 or above) also returns extra_info_value when the saved extra info has typed text.
| JSON Sample File – resv_extra_infos |
| {    "resv_extra_info_id": "8af0ccdf-fcde-46d6-885f-3e659dbf3b06",    "extra_type_id": "12",    "extra_option_id": "34",    "extra_info_value": "50th birthday, cake with candles" } |
| Variable Name | Value | Data Type | Mandatory | Description |
| resv_extra_info_id | 8af0ccdf-fcde-46d6-885f-3e659dbf3b06 | String | Y | TmsResvExtraInfo Id |
| extra_type_id | 12 | String | Y | TmsExtraType Id |
| extra_option_id | 34 | String | N | TmsExtraOption Id. Omitted when empty / 0 |
| extra_info_value | 50th birthday, cake with candles | String | N | Typed custom text. Omitted when empty |

requirement.release_notes:
Enhancements: [Jira-58101] - TMS 2.0 - Add Aspen owner code and status on Aspen display
Description:
Add a new result display field "Owens Code" for Aspen.
Setup:
Go to Table Management System > Other Settings > Config by Location page, find the "Interface Result Fields On New Reservation" setting and edit it.
Added a new field "Owner Code" in the "Interface Result Fields On New Reservation" settings(Note: The "Status" field does not need to be added as "Member Status" field that already exists).
When editing or adding interfaces set by aspen, can find the newly added fields in the fields.
Tick it and save the settings.
Go to Other Settings > Themes page, edit a "New Reservation" or "Walk In" Section within an existing theme.
Can find "aspen" newly added "[Result] Owner Code" under the "Interface" in the "Field" tab on the right.
Drag it to the tag belonging to member aspen and save the theme.
Go to TMS Operation > New Reservation page, switch the right-hand tab to "member aspen" and can find the newly added "Owner Code" field in the fields below.
Use the search button under Aspen to search for members, if the member has an "Owner Code", it will be displayed in the "[Result] Owner Code" input box.
Save reservation, this information will not be saved in the profile.
Go to Walk In, use Aspen search button to search for members, and if there is an "Owner Code" content, it will also be displayed in the input box.
Save reservation, this information will not be saved in the profile.
